31. ESTABLISHING  AAVIN  PARLOUR FOR DIFFERENTLY ABLED PERSONS 
 
 
1. 
Gist of the Scheme 
The Government have issued orders for establishing aavin 
parlours by providing Rs.50000/- per beneficiary to sale 
aavin products and for creating self employment 
opportunities for the Differently Abled Persons.  
2. 
Eligibility Criteria 
Any differently abled persons in the age group of 18 and 
above. 
3. 
Whether 
form 
of 
application is prescribed 
Yes.  Application are available with the District Differently 
Abled Welfare Officer. 
4. 
Certificates to be 
furnished 
National Identity Card for Differently Abled and Family 
Card. 
5. 
Officer to 
whom the 
application is 
to 
be 
submitted 
All District Differently Abled Welfare Officer 
 
 
6. 
Grievances if any to be 
addressed to 
Assistant Director (Placement),

Abled,

Chennai – 600 005.
